title: IndiaAI Mission budget allocation, 2025-26
summary: The Union Budget 2025-26 allocated ₹2,000 crore to the IndiaAI Mission under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, a large rise on the previous year. According to PRS Legislative Research, the allocation was cut to ₹800 crore at the revised estimate stage, and the mission's spending has stayed below half of its allocations since launch. This figure is the budget estimate, a yearly tranche of the five-year mission outlay of ₹10,371.92 crore.
purpose: Annual budget estimate for implementing the IndiaAI Mission in 2025-26.
